transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, I came in because... I just can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. It's been really overwhelming. I feel like I'm a bad employee, a bad homeowner... and honestly, I just feel like I deserve to lose everything I've worked for.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been a long time. Um, I'd say the depression... and just not caring about things I used to like... it's been going on for about two years and one month now.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I really have. Um... I used to do a lot. I would plan brunches, paint in the spare room, go hiking, and even sign up for networking events. But now... I don't know, doing any of those things just feels like a task that I'm pretending to care about.
Do you still experience pleasure when you do engage in these activities, even if it feels like a task?

Um, no, not really. Like I was just saying, even if I force myself to go to a brunch or try to paint, I don't get any joy out of it anymore. I'm really just going through the motions. There's no actual pleasure left in any of it... it just feels like I'm pretending to care until it's over.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about the future?
Um, I don't know that I'd say I'm anxious or worried about the future. It's more just... I don't really think about it. I don't have the energy to worry about what's coming, honestly.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt significantly better than you do now?

Not really. Um, looking back... the low mood and that loss of interest have been there for almost the whole time since this started. There have only been, I guess, really brief periods where I could function a little better. But no, I haven't had any times where I felt significantly better.
Have you ever had an episode of depression before the one that started two years and one month ago?
No, I don't think so. Um, before all this started a couple of years ago, I was pretty much fine. I never really dealt with depression or... or felt anything like this before then.
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your lifetime?
No, just this one. Like I was just saying, I was fine before all this started a couple of years ago. So it's really just been this one long stretch of feeling like this, not separate episodes.
Has your low mood or loss of interest in activities lasted without any significant improvement for the past two years?

Yes, exactly. Like I mentioned a minute ago, looking back... the low mood and that loss of interest have just been there for almost the whole time since this all started. I've only had very brief windows where I felt like I could function a little better, but otherwise, no, there hasn't been any real improvement over these past couple of years.
Have you experienced any significant improvement in your symptoms that lasted for at least two months at any point during the past two years?
No, definitely not. Like I said, it's just been one long stretch. I haven't had any period where I felt better for two whole months. It's just been pretty constant.
Have you experienced any periods of at least two months without depressive symptoms since this started two years and one month ago?
No, like I just said a second ago, I really haven't. There definitely hasn't been any two-month stretch where I felt okay or back to normal. It's just been pretty constant this whole time.
Do you think your current feelings of depression will ever improve?

I... honestly, I don't know. It's hard to imagine things getting better when it's been this way for so long. I mean, I'd like to think it will improve eventually, but right now, I'm just really not sure.
Do you think this episode of depression will last your entire lifetime?

I really don't know. Um, I certainly hope not. Like I said, it feels like it's never going to end sometimes just because it's been so constant, but... I can't say for sure if it'll actually last my entire life. I just don't know.
Do you think it's possible for your depression to change or improve at some point in the future?

I mean, I guess it's possible. I don't have a crystal ball or anything. But when you're in the middle of it, day after day, it's just really hard to see how it could change. So, maybe? I just don't see it right now.
Do you think your feelings of depression have been present every day for the past two years?

Yeah, pretty much. Actually, um, the depression and just that complete loss of interest in things... it's been with me for about two years and one month now. So, yes, every day for at least that long.
Have you experienced any periods where your depressive symptoms significantly improved for a while before getting worse again during the past two years?

Not really. Um, looking back, the low mood and that loss of interest have been there for almost the entire time since this started. I guess there were a few, like, really brief periods where I could function just a little bit better... but it never lasted long enough to feel like a significant improvement. It always just went right back to how it was.
